You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 5daec17e32df9f9d284c8792bdd67b70af9589c0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Frank Morgner <frankmorgner@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2018 13:31:00 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] ias/ecc: ignore missing serial on card initialization

fixes problem in card detection introduced in
50b000047c44b1f2c6f0134094c19519d512e5b6
---
 src/libopensc/card-iasecc.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/libopensc/card-iasecc.c b/src/libopensc/card-iasecc.c
index 526d0716..05d13fce 100644
--- a/src/libopensc/card-iasecc.c
+++ b/src/libopensc/card-iasecc.c
@@ -615,7 +615,7 @@ iasecc_init(struct sc_card *card)
 			LOG_TEST_RET(ctx, rv, "Select EF.ATR AID failed");
 		}
 
-		rv = iasecc_get_serialnr(card, NULL);
+		iasecc_get_serialnr(card, NULL);
 	}
 
 #ifdef ENABLE_SM
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to handle the case where the card's serial number is missing during initialization. The previous implementation attempted to assign the return value of the `iasecc_get_serialnr` function to a variable (`rv`), which likely led to an error if the serial number was not present. The patch modifies this behavior by ignoring the return value, allowing the card initialization to proceed even if the serial number is not available, thus fixing the card detection issue.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the failure to handle the case where the card's serial number is missing during initialization. The previous implementation attempted to assign the return value of the `iasecc_get_serialnr` function to a variable (`rv`), which likely led to an error if the serial number was not present. The patch modifies this behavior by ignoring the return value, allowing the card initialization to proceed even if the serial number is not available, thus fixing the card detection issue.
